rationale: One syscall's errno table, with the gaps localized to two missing argument checks in code that already exists. epoll_ctl02 asserts exactly nine error cases for epoll_ctl(): EBADF on an invalid epfd, EPERM on an fd that does not support epoll, EBADF on an invalid fd, EINVAL on an unsupported op, EINVAL when fd == epfd, EFAULT on a NULL event pointer, ENOENT on EPOLL_CTL_DEL of an unregistered fd, ENOENT on EPOLL_CTL_MOD of an unregistered fd, and EEXIST on EPOLL_CTL_ADD of an already-registered fd. Reading the implementation, most of that table is already satisfied: kernel/src/syscall/epoll.rs:82 returns EINVAL for an unrecognized op, the read_val::<c_epoll_event>() calls at lines 70 and 76 yield EFAULT for a NULL event pointer, get_file_fast! supplies EBADF for both bad fds, and kernel/src/events/epoll/file.rs:100-105 already returns EEXIST for a duplicate EPOLL_CTL_ADD. Exactly two checks are absent, and grep confirms both: EPERM appears nowhere in kernel/src/events/epoll/ or kernel/src/syscall/epoll.rs, so adding a non-pollable fd (the test uses an O_DIRECTORY fd, whose InodeHandle::poll at kernel/src/fs/file/inode_handle.rs:252-262 unconditionally reports IN|OUT rather than declining) succeeds where Linux returns EPERM; and 'epfd' appears nowhere under kernel/src/events/epoll/, so there is no fd == epfd self-add rejection. Both are additive guards in sys_epoll_ctl / EpollFile::control, not a subsystem Asterinas lacks -- epoll itself works, since epoll_create01/02, epoll_create1_01/02, epoll01, epoll_ctl01, epoll_ctl03, epoll_wait01/03/04/07 and epoll_pwait01/02/04/05/06 are all already enabled in all.txt. Measured, not assumed: epoll_ctl02 passes all 9 subtests on the host with the pinned LTP 20260529 binary, and fails in Asterinas at base e8f2b9ca6 in this run's probe boot, so the defect is Asterinas's. Ground no earlier round covered: rounds 1-3 (run-7UHmXC fsync03, run-atDPcd dup02, run-iIbwju clock_getres01) all took all.txt entries but none touched epoll. Preferred over the other candidates this run measured. Rejected fdatasync02 as duplicate work: its two cases are EBADF on fd -1 and EINVAL on /dev/null, the same as-inode-handle gate that run-7UHmXC's fsync03 fix already rewrote on branch fix-ltp-fsync03-7UHmXC (that commit edits kernel/src/syscall/fsync.rs sys_fdatasync directly), and although that branch is not an ancestor of my base, re-fixing it would collide rather than add coverage. Rejected the seven broken candidates -- shutdown01, shutdown02, getsockname01, getpeername01, pipe2_01, pipe2_02, pipe2_04 -- because 'broken' is a setup or harness break, not a clean assert failure, and it would have to be untangled before any kernel defect is visible; shutdown01 also burned 50s of the boot's 50.2s total, suggesting a hang. Rejected mkdir02 (needs setregid/setreuid plus S_ISGID and GID inheritance through the directory-creation path, a permissions subsystem), getcpu01 (depends on sched_setaffinity plus a /sys/devices/system/node topology Asterinas does not export, and sched_setaffinity01 is itself a known failure), abort01 (needs core-dump generation and WCOREDUMP plus SIGIOT semantics -- core dumping is a whole feature, not a check), and clock_gettime04 (a 10000-iteration timing-jitter test over 6 clocks and 6 variants including vDSO, whose 5ms tolerance makes it inherently flaky under emulation, and it partly overlaps the vdso hrtimer_res defect run-iIbwju already diagnosed). Also considered and rejected the untouched ext2/exfat blocked pools: their only distinct entries beyond exfat duplicates are renameat201 and renameat202, both of which need RENAME_EXCHANGE implemented in the ext2 and exfat filesystems -- kernel/src/fs/fs_impls/ext2/impl_for_vfs/inode.rs:221 and kernel/src/fs/fs_impls/exfat/inode.rs:1659 both explicitly return EINVAL with 'RENAME_EXCHANGE is not supported' -- which is a filesystem-level feature gap rather than a localized defect, and all.txt is the higher-priority pool anyway.
notes: Pool line is all.txt:184, '# epoll_ctl02'. Default configuration: entry comes from all.txt, so no CONFORMANCE_TEST_WORKDIR override and run_vars is empty. Host baseline binary: /nix/store/hik6kb512ia3p14lc2vwzb292d4k306a-ltp-20260529/testcases/bin/epoll_ctl02 (all 9 TPASS). Test source: /nix/store/6is5pwis1dp779rjcf6n5kgyp6xlrmln-source/testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_ctl/epoll_ctl02.c. Probe boot also measured 12 other candidates; all appended to select.cache (6 fail, 7 broken recorded as fail with note). Note for diagnose: the EPERM case likely needs a way for a file description to decline epoll registration rather than an inode-type check, since InodeHandle::poll currently reports IN|OUT for every inode including directories. The remaining ~970 commented all.txt entries and 52 cached stale-entry passes stay available for later rounds.
